verdict.rationale: Google endpoint management provides native enrollment, policy enforcement (password requirements, context-aware access), and remote wipe of accounts from mobile devices, all tied to Workspace identity (docs-8, docs-9, docs-17, docs-28). However, community reports describe real friction: full context-aware/device-security enforcement is effectively Chrome-dependent, locking out other browsers, and admins report no clear way to diagnose which policy blocked access, calling enterprise CAA policy debugging 'extremely painful and error prone' (comm-1, comm-3, comm-4). This is a genuine caveat on policy enforcement usability rather than a full contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: independent verification that remote lock/wipe works reliably in practice, and clearer non-Chrome device parity.
